text:
these sheet pan chicken shawarma bowls are our go to for an easy, tasty weeknight meal🍗🥒🍚paired with a creamy cucumber chickpea salad & buttery dill rice- this needs to be on your rotation asap!

for the full step-by-step instructions, go to my link in bio or comment “recipe” and I’ll send you a direct link to my website! 

Ingredients:
- 2 lbs chicken thighs
- 1 1/2 cups plain Greek yogurt
- 2 tbsps tomato paste
- 1 lemon
- 9 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp smoked paprika
- 3 tsps oregano
- 2 1/2 tsps cumin
- 1/2 tsp cinnamon
- 6 tsps onion powder
- 4 1/2 tsps salt
- 4 tsps black pepper
- 2 tsps smoked paprika
- 2 tsps garlic powder
- 15 1/2 ozs chickpeas
- 1/4 cup parsley
- 1 bunch green onions
- 1 cucumber
- 5 ozs feta, crumbled
- 2 cups jasmine rice, cooked
- 3 tbsps butter
- 1/4 cup dill
- 4 garlic naan bread
